title: [review] schc_adaptation.json: Field sum vs residue_bit_length discrepa
description: Rule 1 fields sum to 286 bits (8+120+120+4+4+2+4+8+16) but residue_bit_length is 320 bits. 34-bit discrepancy unexplained. Provenance acknowledges mismatch ('Actual observed ~40-42B') but doesn't clarify which additional fields contribute.
